svg.title: Replay of our level 6 program: 36-cell pattern × 5 copies · 27 lines
svg.desc: Animated replay, tick by tick, of our final program for level 6 medium case 59 (board radius 5): six laser emitters move along the rail and toggle on and off; cells hit by exactly two beams become matter. The 36-cell pattern is collected 5 times, at ticks 7, 12, 17, 22, 27, in 27 lines.
